text.tspan: Decadal average: Annual number of people requiring immediate
assistance due to all natural disasters World, 1900 to 2020
Decadal figures are measured as the annual average over the subsequent ten-year period. Disasters include events such as
earthquakes, volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods.

tspan.tspan: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
